game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: TODV
quote: This game has become repetitive, and with each new installment, it veers further toward depravity. As a player, I want freedom, but that doesn’t mean I want to be forced to watch lewd, explicit content while playing. They claimed these changes were meant to introduce "couples" and a modern touch to the game world, but what we’re actually seeing is the height of vulgarity. I cannot—and will not—continue playing it. Furthermore, the 30-fps cap feels intentional—just another sign of pure greed. Sadly, this is a game best forgotten.
